title: Pharmacy Benefit Exhibit: Part D Deductible and Thirty-Day Retail Cost Share by Group Retiree Plan
content:
Part D prescription drug coverage is carried on every plan of the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans. The Part D deductible for the plan year and the member cost share on a 30-day retail fill are scheduled per plan below; the generic and preferred brand figures are copays in USD, and the specialty figure is a coinsurance percentage.

| Group plan | Part D coverage carried | Part D deductible for the plan year | 30-day generic fill | 30-day preferred brand fill | 30-day specialty fill |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO) | Yes | 250.00 | 10.00 | 40.00 | 30 percent |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Enhanced (PPO) | Yes | 100.00 | 8.00 | 35.00 | 25 percent |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) | Yes | 0 | 5.00 | 25.00 | 20 percent |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP) | Yes | 300.00 | 12.00 | 45.00 | 33 percent |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Enhanced (EGWP) | Yes | 150.00 | 9.00 | 38.00 | 28 percent |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP) | Yes | 0 | 5.00 | 28.00 | 22 percent |

## Reading of the exhibit

Part D coverage is carried on all six plans of the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans without exception; the book holds no plan for which this column reads otherwise.

The deductible is scheduled at 0 on two plans, Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) and Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP). The highest figure in the book, 300.00, stands against Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP).

The generic and preferred brand figures are fixed amounts for a 30-day fill, while the specialty figure is a share of the cost of the fill; a specialty fill therefore has no fixed amount scheduled for it anywhere in this exhibit.
